exposure: Type of delivery (vaginal delivery, urgent C-section, elective C-section)
Vaginal delivery vs. urgent C-section vs. elective C-section
cohort: 88 nulliparous women with gestational age of 39 weeks and above
finding: While NO metabolites levels decreased after delivery in all groups, the decrease was greater in the C-section groups (both urgent and elective) compared to the vaginal delivery group, suggesting that C-section may cause more endothelial disruption than vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: C-section (both urgent and elective) was associated with a greater reduction in NO metabolites levels compared to vaginal delivery.
